name: Himesho!
source: Our protagonist Yamada Koharu is told two surprising news at the same time: he's transferring to a former all-girls school and he's actually the heir to the throne, so several princesses from different countries will try to become his queen!
translation: 主人公山田小春同时得知两条惊人消息：自己即将转入一所由女校改制而来的学校，而且竟然还是王位继承人。来自不同国家的几位公主将努力成为他的王后！
